statement: (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let S := fun (X q : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ Nat.Coprime (p+2) q)).sum (fun p => Real.log p); let V := fun (q : ℕ) => q.primeFactors.prod (fun r => 1-1/((r:ℝ)-1)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (X q : ℕ), 2 ≤ X → q ≤ X → Odd q → Squarefree q → |S X q-(X:ℝ)/50*V q| ≤ C*(q.divisors.card:ℝ)*Real.sqrt X*(Real.log (2*(q:ℝ)*X))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0065 · 计算同窗真素数乘差二轮筛的主项与误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0065 · Compute the main term and error for a gap-two wheel on actual primes in the window

brief.zh: 只在第二端施加 q 的互素遮罩。用 Möbius 容斥，TP-0030 给每个 d∣q 的实际 −2 类进程误差。有限乘积的局部因子是 1−1/(r−1)，保留 q=1 和绝对误差。可给 Θ 测试的真素数端一阶归一化。
brief.en: Apply the coprimality mask only to the translated endpoint. Use Möbius inclusion and exclusion with the actual −2 progression bound TP-0030 for each d∣q. The finite product has factors 1−1/(r−1), including the empty product at q=1. This gives a first-moment normalization on the prime side of the theta test.
